item.title: Xbox Partner Preview live stream set for March 26
item.description: Microsoft Gaming will host an Xbox Partner Preview live stream on March 26 at 10:00 a.m. PT / 1:00 pm. ET, the company announced. You will be able to watch it on YouTube and Twitch.

item.title: Atomic Owl for PS5, Xbox Series, PS4, Xbox One, and Switch launches May 20
item.description: Side-scrolling roguelike action platformer Atomic Owl will launch for PlayStation 5, Xbox Series, PlayStation 4, Xbox One, and Switch on May 20 for $12.99 / €12.99 with a 10 percent-off launch disc…

item.description: Squanch Games has delayed the Switch 2 version ofÂ High On Life 2 from its previously planned April 20 release date to July 1.

item.title: Worshippers of Cthulhu for Xbox Series launches March 27
item.description: The Xbox Series version of Cthulhu-themed city builder Worshippers of Cthulhu will launch on March 27, publisher Crytivo and developer Crazy Goat Games announced.

item.title: Crimson Desert sales top three million
item.description: Total sales for open-world action adventure game Crimson Desert have surpassed three million units, developer Pearl Abyss announced.

item.title: Pokemon Champions for Switch launches April 8

item.title: Reforged Studios acquires Headup
item.description: Reforged Studios has acquired German independent games publisher Headup, the companies announced. Financial terms of the transaction were not disclosed.

item.title: Epic Games lays off over 1,000 employees
item.description: Epic Games has laid off over 1,000 employees, the company announced.

item.title: Albion Online coming to Xbox Series on April 21
item.description: Sandbox Interactive will release free-to-play medieval fantasy sandbox massively multiplayer online RPG Albion Online for Xbox Series on April 21 with full cross-play, the developer announced.

item.title: Behaviour Interactive acquires The Fun Pimps
item.description: Dead by Daylight developer Behaviour Interactive has acquired 7 Days to Die developer The Fun Pimps, the companies announced.

item.title: Virtual reality co-op heist game PAYDAY: Aces High announced for SteamVR, Quest
item.description: Fast Travel Games, in partnership with Starbreeze Entertainment, has announced virtual reality cooperative heist game PAYDAY: Aces High for SteamVR and Quest. It will launch in 2026.

item.title: Open-world virtual reality flying adventure game Compass announced for PS VR2, SteamVR, and Quest
item.description: Trebuchet has announced open-world virtual reality flying adventure game Compass for PlayStation VR2, SteamVR, and Quest. It will launch this spring.
